name: Ootori Haruyuki
source: Despite his young age, managed to become the CEO of a large corporation. Considerably famous for his business prowess and youth, his name often makes it in headlines. He leaves a lasting impression on people due to his charming smile and handsome looks. Has a tendency to ask unreasonable things of his employees all while wearing a smile. He was the one who ordered Hyoga Akihito to create a new team to develop a new product in time for Christmas.
